name: Subconscious Motion
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level arcanist 1, bard 1, medium 1, mesmerist 1, psychic 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, spiritualist 1, witch 1; Focus hand 1, opportunist 1, supremacy 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action
Components S

EFFECT

Range Close
Target One conscious or sleeping creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Will negates or none (see below); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

With a small mental nudge, you steer the target to take a single, simple action of your choosing. This action must be something the target would normally do in the current context and can be completed in a single move or free action. The spell cannot interrupt something the target is already doing, making it more effective while the target is idle. However, you may influence an action the creature is already doing at the time of casting to change the outcome, without changing the action itself. For example, a target reaching for its weapon could be made to reach for a different item, or when talking, it may be made to address a different creature. The action must be simple enough not to require a roll, check, or specialized training such as a feat or class feature. It can, however, be a racial ability, including a magical one. The target can be made to communicate, but you cannot decide what it will say. If it was already going to convey something, it will convey that same idea to the recipient dictated by you. Otherwise, it will attempt to come up with something to say, limited by its Charisma score. R sleeping creature can be made to do actions that do not wake it up. It cannot be made to sleepwalk, but its actions can be influenced when it is already sleepwalking. Creatures unconscious for other reasons are not valid targets. R target who does not realize a spell is being cast on it cannot attempt a saving throw, nor is it innately aware of the action you made it take. If the action is pointed out to it, it will chalk it up to autopilot and not suspect outside influence. Even if a creature knows what spell was cast on it, it won’t be able to tell what action you suggested, whether it passes its saving throw or not.
